run_amalgamate_c_files: run amalgamate.py with output c file, header file, and list of source files to amalgamate

parse_include_directive: parse a C preprocessor include directive line and extract the included file path

review_process_include_method: review the _process_include method that resolves and inlines upb header includes during amalgamation
